title: Pandits, The Religious Scholars, Read And Read,
summary: Attachment is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Shalok, Third Mehla:; the Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud,
lifeApplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Shalok, Third Mehla:; the Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud,
source.lifeApplication: Let the wider line hold together what the mind wants to split apart.

evidence.coreClaim: Shalok, Third Mehla:; the Pandits, the religious scholars, read and read, and shout out loud,
evidence.turn: Attachment steadies when they lose their lives uselessly; they die, only to be re-born, over and over.
evidence.practicalImplication: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
